sections.overview: This marine snailfish (Liparidae) is known from the western North Atlantic; records place it east of New Jersey.
sections.identification: It is a small species described from a single type specimen; detailed identification relies on specialist anatomical characters.
sections.habitat: The type record is from the continental slope region of the western North Atlantic. Available sources do not establish its full depth range.
sections.diet: No species-specific diet data were found in the consulted accounts.
sections.behavior: Its behavior is not described in the consulted sources.
sections.reproduction: The consulted sources report no reproductive observations.
sections.ecology: The species is exceptionally poorly documented: the taxonomic account reports only the type specimen. P. griseus is another Psednos, recorded off Isla Guadalupe in the eastern Pacific, far from this western North Atlantic type locality.
sections.conservation: The consulted FishBase listing does not provide an IUCN assessment for this species.
